rav.text: The Rakdos guild spreads terror in this story: its defilers chase Tajic into a square where Rakdos and Gruul slaughter each other while the Boros close in, and a Rakdos massacre of a Selesnyan vernadi leads Nikya to declare war on the Rakdos. Kal's fire spell then destroys the demons and nearly all of the raiders, though Massacre Girl escapes.

The demon Rakdos himself is a force in the guild's crisis, as he kills one of the nephilim in the center of Ravnica City, and when Project Kraj battles him both are defeated. As the guilds return to ascendance, most get new guildmasters except the Izzet, Orzhov and Rakdos.

rtr.text: Rakdos has awakened and been restored to full power, after he was dumped unconscious into his lava pit, and when he stirs, the cult's bloodletting resumes and everyone else's nightmare begins. His reach is long, as Cryptwitch Merree vanishes after a spat with Rakdos and his snap of the fingers severs a connection to the Worldsoul that took years to join.
The Rakdos guild also hunts Jek and Vinni over a Dimir key in the Ninth District, and kidnaps Emmara Tandris, which pulls Jace back into the guild war.
The Rakdos guild parades through the streets to open the Slaughter Games, and in the Ninth Rakdos and Gruul slaughter each other in the center of the square while the Boros contain them.

gtc.text: The Rakdos fight the Gruul as a massacre of a Selesnyan healer's camp is blamed on them, and a Rakdos bloodwitch summons batlike demons from the earth, turning the tide against the Zhur-Taa until Kal's fire-and-lightning spell incinerates the remaining Rakdos. Tired of Boros interference, the Rakdos also unleash hellraiser goblins.
Aurelia tells Gideon that the Rakdos and Gruul tug and tear apart the contested Ninth, and that he saved a Boros brigade from a Rakdos ambush.

clu.text: On this set's cards, Rakdos appears as the demon leader of the Rakdos Cult.

dis.text: At the Decamillennial Izolda uses dragon spinal fluid and the blood of Jarad and Myc to rouse Rakdos, who wreaks havoc until absorbed by Project Kraj. Rakdos relishes entertainment with his dinner and calls on his servants to rage, renewing ancient power in blood.
Once Kraj absorbs him and goes still, the comatose Rakdos is thrown back into his lava pit by the Boros angel Feather. Sensing weakness after his defeat, Izolda's followers devour her alive.
